title: Miradi ambayo nilikuwa Mjapani pekee ilikuwa yenye thawabu zaidi

text.The projects where I was the only Japane: Miradi ambayo nilikuwa Mjapani pekee ilikuwa yenye thawabu zaidi
text.There was a project where I was the only: Kulikuwa na mradi ambapo nilikuwa Mjapani pekee kwenye timu 🐧
text.Passing on what the client said, and exp: Kupitisha kile mteja alisema, na kuelezea kile wahandisi walijenga, yote yalikuwa kazi yangu.
text.So before a meeting, I decided the order: Kwa hivyo kabla ya mkutano, niliamua kuagiza kuzungumza, na nikatengeneza slaidi kabla ya kuingia.
text.With slides, the client understands easi: Pamoja na slaidi, mteja anaelewa kwa urahisi, na mimi pia sipotei.
text.It was hard, but this was the project wh: Ilikuwa ngumu, lakini huu ulikuwa mradi ambapo nilihisi kuthawabishwa zaidi.
text.The client's thank you email was the hap: Barua pepe ya shukrani ya mteja ilikuwa wakati wa furaha zaidi niliokuwa nao kazini
text.I decided to follow the buffer the PM ma: niliamua kufuata bafa ya PM bila kulalamika
